contextFields.turn: battle.turn (choices for turn N are committed while battle.turn === N; turn 0 = leads/team preview)
contextFields.actor: slot label p1a/p1b/p2a/p2b of the acting/affected mon (resolved from the context expression)
contextFields.target: slot label of the other mon
contextFields.hit: battle.activeMove.hit (1-based multi-hit index; 0/1 for single hit)
contextFields.ord: occurrence index of an otherwise-identical key within the battle (e.g. secondary #2 of Fire Fang)
contextFields.tied: sorted canonical labels of the tied elements of a speedSort shuffle (perm outcome = labels in result order)
contextFields.event: id of the runEvent/fieldEvent whose handler list is being sorted

callsites.decides: order in which equal-speed active mons run an eachEvent (e.g. Update after Weather)

callsites.decides: order of tied handlers in fieldEvent (Residual, SwitchIn)
callsites.notes: End-of-turn residual order and switch-in ability order among speed-tied holders. Observable (e.g. who gets Intimidated first, Leftovers vs poison order across mons).

callsites.decides: order of tied handlers inside runEvent
callsites.notes: Fires very often (any event with >=2 equal-priority handlers from different holders, e.g. two Pokémon with same Speed both listening to an "Any" event). Mostly unobservable; most frequent draw kind by count.
